name: gamelift
description: Amazon GameLift Servers provides solutions for hosting session-based multiplayer game servers in the cloud, including tools for deploying, operating, and scaling game servers.

subcommands.name: accept-match
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Registers a player's acceptance or rejection of a proposed FlexMatch match.

subcommands.name: claim-game-server
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Locates an available game server and temporarily reserves it to host gameplay and players.

subcommands.name: create-alias
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Creates an alias for a fleet.

subcommands.name: create-build
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere Creates a new Amazon GameLift Servers build resource for your game server binary files.

subcommands.name: create-container-fleet
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Creates a managed fleet of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instances to host your containerized game servers.

subcommands.name: create-container-group-definition
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Creates a ContainerGroupDefinition that describes a set of containers for hosting your game server with Amazon GameLift Servers managed containers hosting.

subcommands.name: create-fleet
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Creates a fleet of compute resources to host your game servers.

subcommands.name: create-fleet-locations
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Adds remote locations to an EC2 and begins populating the new locations with instances.

subcommands.name: create-game-server-group
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Creates a Amazon GameLift Servers FleetIQ game server group for managing game hosting on a collection of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud instances for game hosting.

subcommands.name: create-game-session
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Creates a multiplayer game session for players in a specific fleet location.

subcommands.name: create-game-session-queue
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Creates a placement queue that processes requests for new game sessions.

subcommands.name: create-location
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Anywhere Creates a custom location for use in an Anywhere fleet.

subcommands.name: create-matchmaking-configuration
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Defines a new matchmaking configuration for use with FlexMatch.

subcommands.name: create-matchmaking-rule-set
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Creates a new rule set for FlexMatch matchmaking.

subcommands.name: create-player-session
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Reserves an open player slot in a game session for a player.

subcommands.name: create-player-sessions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Reserves open slots in a game session for a group of players.

subcommands.name: create-script
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere Creates a new script record for your Amazon GameLift Servers Realtime script.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-peering-authorization
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Requests authorization to create or delete a peer connection between the VPC for your Amazon GameLift Servers fleet and a virtual private cloud (VPC) in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-peering-connection
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Establishes a VPC peering connection between a virtual private cloud (VPC) in an Amazon Web Services account with the VPC for your Amazon GameLift Servers fleet.

subcommands.name: delete-alias
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Deletes an alias.

subcommands.name: delete-build
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Deletes a build.

subcommands.name: delete-container-fleet
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Deletes all resources and information related to a container fleet and shuts down currently running fleet instances, including those in remote locations.

subcommands.name: delete-container-group-definition
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Request options: Deletes a container group definition.

subcommands.name: delete-fleet
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Deletes all resources and information related to a fleet and shuts down any currently running fleet instances, including those in remote locations.

subcommands.name: delete-fleet-locations
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Removes locations from a multi-location fleet.

subcommands.name: delete-game-server-group
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Terminates a game server group and permanently deletes the game server group record.

subcommands.name: delete-game-session-queue
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Deletes a game session queue.

subcommands.name: delete-location
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Anywhere Deletes a custom location.

subcommands.name: delete-matchmaking-configuration
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Permanently removes a FlexMatch matchmaking configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-matchmaking-rule-set
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Deletes an existing matchmaking rule set.

subcommands.name: delete-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Deletes a fleet scaling policy.

subcommands.name: delete-script
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Deletes a Realtime script.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-peering-authorization
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Cancels a pending VPC peering authorization for the specified VPC.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-peering-connection
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Removes a VPC peering connection.

subcommands.name: deregister-compute
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Anywhere Removes a compute resource from an Anywhere fleet.

subcommands.name: deregister-game-server
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Removes the game server from a game server group.

subcommands.name: describe-alias
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves properties for an alias.

subcommands.name: describe-build
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves properties for a custom game build.

subcommands.name: describe-compute
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves properties for a specific compute resource in an Amazon GameLift Servers fleet.

subcommands.name: describe-container-fleet
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves the properties for a container fleet.

subcommands.name: describe-container-group-definition
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves the properties of a container group definition, including all container definitions in the group.

subcommands.name: describe-container-group-port-mappings
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves the port mappings for a container group running on a container fleet.

subcommands.name: describe-ec2-instance-limits
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves the instance limits and current utilization for an Amazon Web Services Region or location.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-attributes
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere Retrieves core fleet-wide properties for fleets in an Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-capacity
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Retrieves the resource capacity settings for one or more fleets.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-deployment
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves information about a managed container fleet deployment.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-events
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves entries from a fleet's event log.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-location-attributes
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Retrieves information on a fleet's remote locations, including life-cycle status and any suspended fleet activity.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-location-capacity
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Retrieves the resource capacity settings for a fleet location.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-location-utilization
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves current usage data for a fleet location.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-port-settings
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Retrieves a fleet's inbound connection permissions.

subcommands.name: describe-fleet-utilization
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Retrieves utilization statistics for one or more fleets.

subcommands.name: describe-game-server
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Retrieves information for a registered game server.

subcommands.name: describe-game-server-group
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Retrieves information on a game server group.

subcommands.name: describe-game-server-instances
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Retrieves status information about the Amazon EC2 instances associated with a Amazon GameLift Servers FleetIQ game server group.

subcommands.name: describe-game-session-details
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves additional game session properties, including the game session protection policy in force, a set of one or more game sessions in a specific fleet location.

subcommands.name: describe-game-session-placement
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves information, including current status, about a game session placement request.

subcommands.name: describe-game-session-queues
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves the properties for one or more game session queues.

subcommands.name: describe-game-sessions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves a set of one or more game sessions in a specific fleet location.

subcommands.name: describe-instances
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types:EC2, Container Retrieves information about the EC2 instances in an Amazon GameLift Servers managed fleet, including instance ID, connection data, and status.

subcommands.name: describe-matchmaking
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves one or more matchmaking tickets.

subcommands.name: describe-matchmaking-configurations
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves the details of FlexMatch matchmaking configurations.

subcommands.name: describe-matchmaking-rule-sets
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves the details for FlexMatch matchmaking rule sets.

subcommands.name: describe-player-sessions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves properties for one or more player sessions.

subcommands.name: describe-runtime-configuration
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves a fleet's runtime configuration settings.

subcommands.name: describe-scaling-policies
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves all scaling policies applied to a fleet.

subcommands.name: describe-script
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves properties for a Realtime script.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-peering-authorizations
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves valid VPC peering authorizations that are pending for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-peering-connections
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves information on VPC peering connections.

subcommands.name: get-compute-access
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Requests authorization to remotely connect to a hosting resource in a Amazon GameLift Servers managed fleet.

subcommands.name: get-compute-auth-token
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Requests an authentication token from Amazon GameLift Servers for a compute resource in an Amazon GameLift Servers fleet.

subcommands.name: get-game-session-log
subcommands.description: Download a compressed log file for a game session.

subcommands.name: get-game-session-log-url
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves the location of stored game session logs for a specified game session on Amazon GameLift Servers managed fleets.

subcommands.name: get-instance-access
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Requests authorization to remotely connect to an instance in an Amazon GameLift Servers managed fleet.

subcommands.name: get-player-connection-details
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (server SDK 5.x or later), Container Retrieves connection details for game clients to connect to game sessions.

subcommands.name: list-aliases
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves all aliases for this Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-builds
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves build resources for all builds associated with the Amazon Web Services account in use.

subcommands.name: list-compute
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves information on the compute resources in an Amazon GameLift Servers fleet.

subcommands.name: list-container-fleets
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves a collection of container fleet resources in an Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-container-group-definition-versions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves all versions of a container group definition.

subcommands.name: list-container-group-definitions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves container group definitions for the Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-fleet-deployments
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Retrieves a collection of container fleet deployments in an Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-fleets
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves a collection of fleet resources in an Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-game-server-groups
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Lists a game server groups.

subcommands.name: list-game-servers
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Retrieves information on all game servers that are currently active in a specified game server group.

subcommands.name: list-locations
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Lists all custom and Amazon Web Services locations where Amazon GameLift Servers can host game servers.

subcommands.name: list-scripts
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves script records for all Realtime scripts that are associated with the Amazon Web Services account in use.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves all tags assigned to a Amazon GameLift Servers resource.

subcommands.name: put-scaling-policy
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Creates or updates a scaling policy for a fleet.

subcommands.name: register-compute
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Anywhere, Container Registers a compute resource in an Amazon GameLift Servers Anywhere fleet.

subcommands.name: register-game-server
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Creates a new game server resource and notifies Amazon GameLift Servers FleetIQ that the game server is ready to host gameplay and players.

subcommands.name: request-upload-credentials
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Retrieves a fresh set of credentials for use when uploading a new set of game build files to Amazon GameLift Servers's Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: resolve-alias
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Attempts to retrieve a fleet ID that is associated with an alias.

subcommands.name: resume-game-server-group
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Reinstates activity on a game server group after it has been suspended.

subcommands.name: search-game-sessions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Retrieves all active game sessions that match a set of search criteria and sorts them into a specified order.

subcommands.name: start-fleet-actions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Resumes certain types of activity on fleet instances that were suspended with StopFleetActions.

subcommands.name: start-game-session-placement
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Makes a request to start a new game session using a game session queue.

subcommands.name: start-match-backfill
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Finds new players to fill open slots in currently running game sessions.

subcommands.name: start-matchmaking
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Uses FlexMatch to create a game match for a group of players based on custom matchmaking rules.

subcommands.name: stop-fleet-actions
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Suspends certain types of activity in a fleet location.

subcommands.name: stop-game-session-placement
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Cancels a game session placement that's in PENDING status.

subcommands.name: stop-matchmaking
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Cancels a matchmaking ticket or match backfill ticket that is currently being processed.

subcommands.name: suspend-game-server-group
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Temporarily stops activity on a game server group without terminating instances or the game server group.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Assigns a tag to an Amazon GameLift Servers resource.

subcommands.name: terminate-game-session
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Ends a game session that's currently in progress.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Removes a tag assigned to a Amazon GameLift Servers resource.

subcommands.name: update-alias
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Updates properties for an alias.

subcommands.name: update-build
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Updates metadata in a build resource, including the build name and version.

subcommands.name: update-container-fleet
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Updates the properties of a managed container fleet.

subcommands.name: update-container-group-definition
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: Container Updates properties in an existing container group definition.

subcommands.name: update-fleet-attributes
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Updates a fleet's mutable attributes, such as game session protection and resource creation limits.

subcommands.name: update-fleet-capacity
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Updates capacity settings for a managed EC2 fleet or managed container fleet.

subcommands.name: update-fleet-port-settings
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Container Updates permissions that allow inbound traffic to connect to game sessions in the fleet.

subcommands.name: update-game-server
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Updates information about a registered game server to help Amazon GameLift Servers FleetIQ track game server availability.

subcommands.name: update-game-server-group
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 (FleetIQ) Updates Amazon GameLift Servers FleetIQ-specific properties for a game server group.

subcommands.name: update-game-session
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Updates the mutable properties of a game session.

subcommands.name: update-game-session-queue
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Updates the configuration of a game session queue, which determines how the queue processes new game session requests.

subcommands.name: update-matchmaking-configuration
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Updates settings for a FlexMatch matchmaking configuration.

subcommands.name: update-runtime-configuration
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Updates the runtime configuration for the specified fleet.

subcommands.name: update-script
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2 Updates Realtime script metadata and content.

subcommands.name: upload-build
subcommands.description: Upload a new build to AWS GameLift.

subcommands.name: validate-matchmaking-rule-set
subcommands.description: This API works with the following fleet types: EC2, Anywhere, Container Validates the syntax of a matchmaking rule or rule set.
